baseline_prompt_en: A photorealistic Gothic fashion portrait of an unmistakably adult woman, with the attached portrait as the sole facial and hair reference, appearing as a solemn fallen-angel maid. She stands in a candlelit manor library and carefully pours tea from a tarnished silver pot into a black porcelain cup. Her formal floor-length black satin maid dress has a high lace collar, fitted long sleeves, a structured waist, ivory cuffs, a layered ankle-length skirt, and a crisp lace headpiece, creating dignified Gothic fashion. Broad charcoal wings fold behind her, a fractured dark halo floats above, and loose feathers rest across the polished floor. Preserve her warm brown almond-shaped eyes, soft oval face, adult facial proportions, natural skin texture, and long glossy wavy black hair. Her expression is calm and self-possessed. Cool moonlight from a tall arched window meets amber candlelight along the feathers and satin. Full-body vertical composition, 50mm lens, realistic fabric and feather texture, restrained color, shallow depth of field.
